row.title: SYNC-BOTH-WAYS-1: tenants pull the platform and lift general code up
row.body: tenantsync now opens its pull requests over REST with the token passed in, clones ultrastable/practical-solutions, measures days behind per tenant and lifts reaching the core, and files Q-SYNC items with their own probes. Seeded systems also pull the kernel weekly with their own token.
